Thus descriptor arguments are not cstring addresses.27f560 selection update creates63c120, waits, holds until flag1;27f630 asserts ready then destroys. Golden20d600 has the same state/flag lifetime through2e74f0 and2e7660, descriptor76f240 points to76f260 -> font/game_helpx2.spr. Old2831c0 calendar update creates descriptor63c170 plus the shared scene sprite pack, waits both and holds flag1;2832b0 destroys both after readiness. Golden20dcf0 requests weather_newsx2.spr and noise.spr from font/weather_news.arc, waits both, adopts SPR objects, waits texture readiness and releases requests before the same flag lifetime. The actual main weather resource field, not a filename similarity, is paired. Steam338950 state0 passes typed32-byte descriptorB0E370 to473230, waits473400, holds flag1 and returns-1 in state3. Its one-name arrayA838B0 resolves93D530. Steam33D0DC materializes array910EB0,33D0F0 loads its two u64 name fields,33D0F4 passes archive93D580, calls46FD20, increments index by8 and bounds it below10 hex: the ordered fields are93D558 weather_newsx2 and93D548 noise. This independently qualifies the actual Steam resource inputs, not just matching filename bytes.

tactic-confirm-queued-voice-offsets.positive_correspondence: Old209dc0 tactical-list confirmation reads/writes tactic105f00/105e30 then enqueues1f99c0(action,2,selected,0,0).
